column1: # The scenario name grammar's shared case table (app#494).
# A scenario name is a directory under scenarios/ (scenarios/<name>/scenario.yaml),
# the middle of challenges/values-scenario-<name>.yaml, and, as `scenario-<name>`,
# the value of the falco-ctf/challenge-id namespace label (deploy-user.sh). It has
# no Go definition; the grammar is: 1 to 54 characters of [a-z0-9-], the first and
# the last a letter or digit. 54 because a label value is at most 63 characters and
# the prefix `scenario-` is 9. The copies this table holds equal:
#   - Go:    internal/catalog (scenario_name_test.go) reads this file, and checks
#            that every real scenarios/<name>/ is accepted.
#   - shell: charts/ctf-user/deploy-user.sh (its SCENARIO_PATTERN), run row by row
# A row is never dropped to make an implementation pass: the implementation that
# Format: the same as internal/identity/testdata/seat-cases.tsv (see its header):
# {U+00EF}, line 1 the canonical `# pattern: ` literal. The table stays ASCII.
# The input is the name AFTER `scenario:`; an empty name is a reject like any other
# --- the first and the last are a letter or digit
# --- length: 54 is the longest (scenario- + 54 = 63, a label value)
# --- the alphabet: lower-case letters, digits, hyphen only
# --- path traversal: the name is a path component
# --- control and bidi characters, a trailing newline
